classification.difficultyReason: Form each resultant, calculate its magnitude and apply the taught reference-angle procedure with quadrant II or IV adjustment.

content.prompt:
Given $\overrightarrow{OX}=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\1\end{pmatrix}$ and $\overrightarrow{OY}=\begin{pmatrix}8\\-3\end{pmatrix}$, find the magnitude and direction of each vector. Give magnitudes to 1 decimal place and directions as angles of inclination to the nearest degree.

Draw a sketch to check your answer.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{XY}&=\overrightarrow{OY}-\overrightarrow{OX}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}8\\-3\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}-2\\1\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}10\\-4\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{XY}|&=\sqrt{10^2+(-4)^2}\\&=2\sqrt{29}\approx10.8\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac4{10}\right)\\\theta&=360^\circ-\alpha\\&\approx338^\circ\end{aligned}$

The vector points right and down, agreeing with the sketch.

spec.description: Authored sketch checking the vector from X to Y.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OX}+\overrightarrow{OY}&=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\1\end{pmatrix}+\begin{pmatrix}8\\-3\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}6\\-2\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{OX}+\overrightarrow{OY}|&=\sqrt{6^2+(-2)^2}\\&=2\sqrt{10}\approx6.3\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac26\right)\\\theta&=360^\circ-\alpha\\&\approx342^\circ\end{aligned}$

The resultant points right and down, agreeing with the sketch.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OX}-\overrightarrow{OY}&=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\1\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}8\\-3\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}-10\\4\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{OX}-\overrightarrow{OY}|&=\sqrt{(-10)^2+4^2}\\&=2\sqrt{29}\approx10.8\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac4{10}\right)\\\theta&=180^\circ-\alpha\\&\approx158^\circ\end{aligned}$

The resultant points left and up, agreeing with the sketch.
